optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.text: Astra is right that header-extra-info is an Ember.Component with no tagName (components/header-extra-info.js.es6:1), so its default div wrapper, not .extra-info-wrapper (header-extra-info.hbs:1), is the flex child of .contents (header.hbs:94, header.scss:15-18); order(2) at topic.scss:30 is indeed a no-op, so my hallucination call was wrong. The comment's remaining claim, that dropping the 5px bullet margin (topic.scss diff :32-34) misaligns the badge, is unproven: the badge sits below the h1 (header-extra-info.hbs:4-15), the PR adds line-height:1.5 to the wrapper, and the #topic-title bullet margin is untouched (topic.scss:10-14). A deliberate spacing change in a layout PR with no demonstrated defect is FP with no subclass.

add-html-sanitizer-for-translated-messag.text: ANCHOR_PATTERN "</?a[^>]*>" (VerifyMessageProperties.java:145) matches <abbr>, <area>, <audio> etc., and santizeAnchors (:150-162) removes such a tag before the policy runs (:88-92). Astra's point holds: the English file maps to itself (:74-75 replaceAll to _en.properties), so an English value with <abbr> strips against itself and passes even though only br/p/strong/b are allowed (:58-61). That makes the new verifier silently miss disallowed HTML for uncommon input, a real wrong result rather than a nit; no current bundle triggers it, which keeps it at medium.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.text: I accept the correction that OrganizerScheduledEmail's subject uses calEvent.title (organizer-scheduled-email.ts:50), but attendees[0].name as the booker is the established cal.com convention (organizer-location-change-email.ts:28, attendee-request-email.ts:24, broken-integration-email.ts:32, organizer-payment-refund-failed-email.ts:15). The new guests are appended via createMany to an existing booking (addGuests.handler.ts:92-106), so the original booker row precedes them and is attendees[0] on the normal path. The missing orderBy is a theoretical guarantee shared by every one of those emails, not a defect introduced here, and the comment's claim that adding guests makes the subject blank does not follow from this code.
